dispute.claim_text: Cardholder disputes a recurring charge, claiming it was billed after they cancelled.

evidence.text: Charge USD 120.00 on 2026-08-31 for service period 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-31.
Cancellation confirmation: 'Your cancellation is effective 2026-08-31, the end of your current billing cycle.'
Usage report sent to cardholder: 14 logins and active use of the service during August 2026.

labels.notes: Merchant-side, medium. The charge was for the final billing cycle (August) used before the cancellation took effect on Aug 31 (ev_002), not a post-cancellation charge. ev_003 shows the service was actively used in that period. The 'services used in the final cycle' nuance is why it is medium, not clear.
